body.body: {"query":"{ jobs(filters: { remote: true, tags: [\"analytics\", \"data\"] }) { id title company { name } externalUrl salaryRange { min max currency } locationPreferences } }"}

={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
  "max_tokens": 600,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Write a short cover letter for Jerry applying to the role of {{ $json.job_title }} at {{ $json.company }}.

Jerry is based in Taiwan and wants async global remote work.

Jerry's background:
- Bilingual English and Mandarin (grew up in California and Taiwan)
- Digital marketing background with data science bootcamp experience
- Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI
- Performance marketing, SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads
- AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor
- Experience with dashboards, EDA, machine learning projects, customer segmentation, fraud detection, and marketing analytics

Make the letter specific to this job. Mention how Jerry can:
- Reduce manual analysis time
- Improve reporting speed
- Connect marketing and data
- Build AI-assisted workflows
- Turn messy data into business action

Job description snippet: {{ $json.description.substring(0, 1000) }}

Keep it under 220 words. Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate. No fluff. No 'I am writing to express my interest.' Just lead with value."
    }
  ]
}
